description: Per-dimension grading contract for the M2.5 fun-proof scenario. The AI agent reads each dimension's required evidence, writes prose justifying a 0-10 score, and emits a verdict (PASS / PARTIAL / NEEDS_FIXES / FUTURE_OWNED). Empty / placeholder / 'looks correct' cells are FAIL by definition.

dimensions.criterion: The agent can distinguish actors, terrain, projectiles, and HUD from the background by visual inspection of the captures alone (no events.jsonl correlation needed).
evidence_required: captures/summary_grid.png — at least 4 frames spanning the run's tick range
events.jsonl — confirm the events ARE firing on the ticks the captures sample

dimensions.criterion: Different terrain materials (dirt, concrete, metal_nohook, anchor) are visually distinguishable in the captures by color or pattern.
evidence_required: captures/summary_grid.png — frames where terrain.terrain_carved fired (carved a dirt/concrete pixel) vs frames where terrain.tool_refused fired (hit metal_nohook or anchor)

dimensions.criterion: Actors (player + reactive guard) render as distinct sprites with positional change visible across frames; not invisible, not glued in place.
evidence_required: captures/summary_grid.png — frames spanning the player's dig action (~tick 22-130) where actor sprite must be visible at the player spawn coords
observe.once — actor positions at run start + run end

dimensions.criterion: Player-visible state changes (dig, refuse, projectile fire, projectile hit, mission resolve) have at least HUD-text feedback visible in the captures. Full juice (dust puff, muzzle flash, screen shake, hit sparks) is post-BP2.
evidence_required: captures/summary_grid.png — frames with HUD labels for: terrain_carved, tool_refused, weapon_fired, mission_resolved
events.jsonl — counts for the above event types

dimensions.criterion: cfctl-driven actions produce a visible engine response within 1-2 ticks (16-33 ms at 60 Hz). 'Visible' here = state change in observe.once or HUD label in next captured frame.
evidence_required: events.jsonl — control.command_accepted timestamps + immediate-next event of the matching type (act.player.dig → terrain_carved at the same/next tick)
captures/summary_grid.png — visual confirmation that the next-tick frame shows the post-action state

dimensions.criterion: When the player digs, the actor's vertical position responds to gravity (drops into the carved hole or stays grounded on a ledge). When the guard fires, projectiles travel at a believable speed (not teleporting to target).
evidence_required: captures/summary_grid.png — frames showing actor vertical position pre + post dig
events.jsonl — projectile_spawned vs projectile_expired tick deltas (projectiles should take >5 ticks to traverse, not 1)

dimensions.criterion: The mission's 30-second timer is observable in the HUD; the player has time to make + execute the strategic choice (preserve dirt shield = idle ~28s; breach dirt shield = 12-15s of digging then expose reactor); the resolution feels earned, not abrupt.
evidence_required: captures/summary_grid.png — HUD timer visible across frames; reactor health bar visible
events.jsonl — mission_resolved tick relative to scenario start (should be ~1799 = 30s @ 60Hz for win path)

dimensions.criterion: The win-vs-loss strategic choice (preserve dirt shield = win; breach dirt shield = loss) is observable in the captures: the agent can tell from the visual + HUD state which path the player chose without reading events.jsonl.
evidence_required: win bundle (m2.5_*_win) captures + loss bundle (m2.5_*_loss) captures — compare the dirt shield region across the two runs
events.jsonl — terrain_carved counts (low for win = ~1; high for loss = 24+)

dimensions.criterion: The scenario delivers its roadmap-stated fun-proof claim: 'M2.5 — Micro Reactor Defense Fun Slice: cf-mission Reactor + DefendReactor objective + LossReason::ReactorDestroyed; dirt-shield strategic-choice scenario where the player chooses to preserve the shield (win) or breach it (loss).'
evidence_required: win bundle — mission.result=won + objective.defend_reactor=completed + 0 reactor_damaged events + dirt shield intact
loss bundle — mission.result=lost + mission.loss_reason=reactor_destroyed + ≥1 reactor_damaged events + dirt shield breached

dimensions.criterion: The scenario exercises BP2's promised systems end-to-end: chunked terrain (M2), reactor world (M2.5), event recorder + replay verifier (M3A). All three must show up in the run bundle's evidence.
evidence_required: events.jsonl — terrain.terrain_carved (M2), reactor_damaged or reactor preserved (M2.5), snapshot.* events at run_started (M3A)
cf-headless replay <bundle> exit 0 with 0 divergences (M3A)

dimensions.criterion: Every milestone-scope cfctl action that this scenario claims to exercise was actually invoked: scenario.reset, act.settings.set, act.player.aim, act.player.dig, sim.run_for_ticks, runbundle.write, system.shutdown.
evidence_required: events.jsonl — control.command_accepted rows for each method

dimensions.criterion: The run bundle contains every artifact the agent needs to grade the other 11 dimensions without re-running the scenario: summary_grid.png + capture_manifest.json + events.jsonl + summary.json + run_manifest.json + observe.once snapshot.
evidence_required: captures/summary_grid.png present + non_blank_ratio>=0.95
captures/capture_manifest.json present
events.jsonl + summary.json + run_manifest.json present + checker-valid
summary.json.artifacts.items[] non-empty (T-CAPTURE evidence recorded)
